nodes.label: Landing-Zone Layered Baseline
nodes.rationale: Treat the repository as an application-focused landing-zone baseline and preserve the landing-zone -> subscription wrapper -> bootstrap -> platform layering unless a minimal, explicit deviation is unavoidable.

nodes.label: Repeatable Desired-State Deployment
nodes.rationale: Changes should be safe to re-run without drift or duplicate resources, favoring declarative Bicep, stable naming, and conditional logic that converges on the same Azure state.

nodes.label: Extension Hook Lifecycle
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Spec Kit commands standardize pre- and post-execution extension hooks so optional prompts and mandatory automation can run around each command consistently.

nodes.label: Requirements Quality Checklist
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Checklists act as unit tests for requirement writing, validating completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage rather than testing implementation behavior.

nodes.label: spec.md / plan.md / tasks.md Artifact Triad
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Analysis and convergence treat spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md as the core intent-bearing artifacts that should stay internally consistent before and after implementation.

nodes.label: User-Story-Oriented Task Phases
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Tasks are organized by user story so each phase is independently testable, incrementally deliverable, and traceable to a specific story goal.

nodes.label: Task-Issue Deduplication by Task ID
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Before creating GitHub issues, existing issue titles are matched against task IDs so reruns do not recreate the same task as duplicate issues.

nodes.label: Pull Request What-If Validation
nodes.rationale: Platform changes are previewed with az deployment group what-if on pull requests before actual deployment on push to main.

nodes.label: Specification Quality Checklist: Standardized Application Onboarding
